name: Hardware-Accelerated AMR Volume Rendering via Homogenization
aliases: Tiling AMR domain with grid patches
definition: An interactive DVR technique for AMR data that subdivides the dataset into regions of constant resolution using an AMR Partition Tree (generalized kD-tree) and renders regions using hardware-accelerated DVR.
summary: This method renders AMR data by tiling the domain into homogeneous grid patches, enabling standard hardware-accelerated volume ray casting without resampling.
